decision: NO-GO on domain-specific training (SFT or otherwise) on current evidence.
reason: Scale (~10^2 turns vs SFT scale), diversity (2 task families, 1 design), success density (mostly negative examples), and candidate quality (alternative underperforms baseline) all point the same way.
